provenance.comparison: Native versus WASM integration reference using the same Swiss model; not an independent astronomical model.
provenance.inputTime: UTC via -utc; Swiss swe_utc_to_jd derives TT and UT1, matching the application binding.
provenance.deltaTModel: Swiss Ephemeris default delta-T model with lunar tidal acceleration explicitly fixed to SE_TIDAL_DE431 (-25.8 arcseconds/century squared) using -tidacc-25.8; matches the application initialization and prevents model changes after ephemeris-file loading.
provenance.conventions: Apparent geocentric tropical ecliptic/equatorial of date; Swiss ephemeris with high-precision speed; longitude-based house cusps.
provenance.rightAscensionNote: Pinned swetest.c case 'a' prints xequ[0] directly in degrees; its help text incorrectly says hours. Source: https://github.com/aloistr/swisseph/blob/f4dcd18e8005dde95fd8a8d2312ed12f9accd1b0/swetest.c
provenance.polarPolicy: Native Porphyry substitute cusps are discarded when the requested construction reports failure.
